description: Capability for the main window. The dialog permissions are listed one by one rather than as `dialog:default` so each one names the call it is there for (JSON takes no comments): `allow-message` is the plugin command behind `ask()` (the native discard / stage / resolve confirmations), `allow-open` the file and folder pickers (open a repository, Locate git…, Locate a tool…), and `allow-save` the Files tab's Save as…, which writes a file at a revision wherever the native save dialog points.
